text: Given a valid flexible_asset_type_id, name and kind, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is called, Then the field is created and the tool returns an envelope whose id matches the one IT Glue returned.

Given only flexible_asset_type_id, name and kind are passed, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is called, Then the upstream request body's attributes contain exactly name and kind -- no optional fields are sent unset.

Given kind="Tag" and tag_type="Contacts" (the gap register's own example), When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is called, Then both values are forwarded unchanged to IT Glue with no local validation.

Given a non-numeric flexible_asset_type_id, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "invalid_argument"}} without calling IT Glue; given a numeric but non-existent type id, IT Glue's 404 is mapped to {"error": {"code": "not_found"}}.
Given the X-ITGlue-API-Key header is missing, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "not_configured", ...}} rather than raising.
notes: Covered generically via the shared run() path (asserted today against get_organization); the new tool goes through the same run() helper unmodified, so no per-tool duplicate is required beyond confirming the live tools/list smoke test during dev self-test.

text: Given IT Glue returns 429 then 201, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is called, Then it retries once honouring Retry-After and returns the successful envelope; given IT Glue returns 403, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false}}.
notes: Error-code mapping and retry/backoff are exercised generically through the shared ITGlueClient.request() path; the new tool reuses that path unmodified, so no per-tool duplicate is required.

text: Given tools/list is queried, When itglue_create_flexible_asset_field is registered, Then it is present with readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, no agent_id parameter, is listed in README's Tools table, and no existing tool loses a name or parameter.
notes: Requires adding an itglue_create_flexible_asset_field entry to tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json in the same change. test_annotations in test_tools.py only spot-checks a fixed tool-name list today and is not extended; the readOnlyHint/destructiveHint claim is checked by the new per-tool test instead.
